frozen_before: any read of a historical outcome column

population.maturity_rule: 60 complete MARKET bars after entry inside the frozen snapshot; calendar only; NO exception for cohorts whose trail happened to fire early
population.maturity_cutoff_derivation: market calendar (union of trading dates across non-index names), not hardcoded

empirical_exit_mix_at_qualification_snap.note: descriptive property of this snapshot, NOT part of the outcome's identity. 91% of exits are the timer, so this is in practice a 60-bar return policy with a rarely-firing trailing stop, and the name says so.

outcome.selection_basis: corrected implementation of the intended trade-path label

terminal_events.payoff_data_checked: corporate_actions.csv is a splice detector; Massive /v3/reference/tickers returns a ticker reference, not merger consideration
terminal_events.return_treatment: excluded from the RETURN numerical estimand
terminal_events.ontology_treatment: retained as a competing event, not as censoring
terminal_events.limitation: the RETURN estimand is CONDITIONAL on a resolvable non-terminal outcome. Terminal events are not assumed to carry zero return or zero selection effect.

search.grammar: BaseSetup + 0..2 contextual tokens, distinct families, base setup REQUIRED
search.universe: fixed exhaustive, enumerated before any outcome exists
search.adaptive_beam: NOT USED — the universe is enumerable, so the search is not outcome-adaptive and the null needs no search replay

deferred.reason: no calibrated null; two separately calibrated 5% bands do not compose into 5% over their union

search.ranking_statistic: theta_hat descending — no stability, novelty or composite score, whose weights would themselves be a fitted model
search.null_generator: G1 within-stratum outcome permutation · REUSED, previously qualified for opportunity-level claims
search.band: Monte-Carlo max statistic over the full fixed universe from 120 permutations — NOT an exact quantile

primary.needle_location: q50 eligible-support claim, chosen X-only before any synthetic outcome exists

power_protocol.detection: T_needle > band_p95 over the FULL opportunity universe — not top-K, not a positive theta

stress_only.note: NOT an alternative route to PASS. One primary gate.

mc_boundary.decision: from the registered band only: PASS / FAIL
mc_boundary.mc_boundary_status: DESCRIPTIVE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY in v1 — a finite-permutation decision procedure is a separate registration, and opening it here would start a new statistical branch on the eve of the search
